label: PRE-BANNER INITIAL SELECTION - GATE NOT PASSED

target_account_state.note: The client shows no token balance and no roll board until the three teams are chosen for the first time. Their absence is a property of the pre-selection state, not missing data, and the target account must not be used to test mechanics.

test_account_observations.account: the operator's own account, never the target
test_account_observations.change_team_after_selection: observed to consume a roll token
test_account_observations.not_used_for: any prior, sample or recommendation for the target account

why_hold.detail: The eight prefixes are hero-conditional. Computing their per-team trigger rates needs hero identity per player-map AND Valve's hero-category membership lists (red/blue/green/purple/yellow, aquatic-fiery-icy, undead-demon-spirit, caped-masked). The category lists are rendered by a client tooltip event and appear in NO shipped file: the localization holds only the tooltip call, not its contents. A single prefix is worth 6 to 11 percent and the top candidates are separated by 0.1 percent, so the bound cannot be shown not to move the pick.
why_hold.would_close_if: the friend's client shows the hero-category lists, or a Tier-1 source for them is found

why_hold.detail: Under the uniform state prior the argmax is PARIVISION / Tundra / Xtreme. Under all four declared alternative prior families the mid argmax becomes Team Falcons, and the support argmax splits between Xtreme and LGD. The distribution-free minimax-regret argmin is different again in every role (Aurora / Falcons / Aurora). Three independent robustness axes do not agree, so no pick is robust.
why_hold.would_close_if: the stat, quality and trait draw weights become known, which the banner reveal itself supplies

attribution.note: Single-factor toggles at 1200 draws, uniform prior, lambda 0.02.

rows.config: old published model (pooled events, scalar banner, historical exposure)
+ exact trait evaluator + TI exposure (the corrected model)

attribution.reading: TI exposure is the dominant correction: it alone flips core and support. The exact banner matters at the margin, flipping support back. Mid is the one stable role across every toggle. Cold-start entering the argmax changed no top-four position once it was represented honestly.

cold_start_correction.first_attempt: pooled the role's series and widened the spread by 1.35
cold_start_correction.why_it_was_wrong: the period score is a MAXIMUM over series, so extra per-series variance wins maxima. Widening for ignorance handed the unobserved roles a manufactured advantage, and it put all three cold-start roles at the top of their tables.
cold_start_correction.fix: a cold-start role borrows one randomly chosen observed team's distribution on every draw, so its mean is the field mean, its spread is a real team's spread, and the uncertainty lives across draws.
cold_start_correction.effect: no cold-start role appears in any role's top four.

deadline.consequence: HOLD cannot run past the lock. If the blockers are not closed, a decision has to be made on the corrected uniform-prior model with its disagreement stated, rather than defaulting to no entry.

superseded_reason: The two blockers it named were re-examined. The coach trigger rates are STRUCTURALLY unobtainable before the first team selection -- the client exposes no Coaching Titles panel while all three roles are empty -- so they cannot be a reason to wait. The banner prior can never be known before the reveal either. Both were converted from blockers into sensitivity axes and the decision was made on prior-family minimax expected regret.
